salary.description: Replacement salary value in provider salary context.

reasonId.description: Tenant submittal reason identifier; not assumed compatible with start cancellation reasons.

timezone.description: Provider scheduling timezone label, retained separately from timestamp offsets.

userFields.description: Custom fields to modify by ID; omitted fields are preserved and [] requests no custom-field changes.

value.description: Replacement textual value; empty requests clearing this field.

items.description: A named custom field and its replacement textual value.

interviewAt.description: Replacement interview instant with explicit offset.

payAgreedAt.description: Replacement pay agreement instant with explicit offset.

internalNotes.description: Replacement internal notes as ordinary text; empty clears text.

externalRejectedAt.description: External rejection instant with explicit offset.

internalRejectedAt.description: Internal rejection instant with explicit offset.

changes.description: Partial field changes; omission preserves values. Null is not accepted, empty text requests clearing, and dates/numeric values cannot be cleared through this contract.

FunctionInput_jobdiva_updatesubmittal.description: The submittal identifier and only the fields to change.

FunctionOutput_jobdiva_updatesubmittal.description: The requested submittal identifier and the update result reported by JobDiva.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-submittals` or `get-submittal`. Supply only changes. Empty text requests clearing, null is unsupported, and userFields updates the named fields rather than deleting unspecified custom fields. Changes can alter status and existing business data. Use `create-start-from-submittal`, not this tool, to record a placement start.

functions.name: update-timesheet-status
functions.description: Change an existing timesheet to pending approval, approved, or rejected, with optional approver comments and adjusted-timesheet context.

userId.description: Internal user ID associated with the status change; omitted to retain provider context.

comments.description: Approver comments; omission leaves comment behavior to JobDiva, empty text is sent explicitly.

timesheetId.description: Internal JobDiva timesheet ID, not an external ID.

adjustedTimesheet.description: Whether the target is an adjusted timesheet; omission uses provider behavior.

FunctionInput_jobdiva_updatetimesheetsta.description: The internal timesheet ID, requested approval state, and optional approval context.

status.description: Requested state accepted by JobDiva, not a downstream processing guarantee.

timesheetId.description: Internal timesheet ID whose status change was accepted.

FunctionOutput_jobdiva_updatetimesheetst.description: The accepted timesheet status change and optional provider success message.

tags.instructions: Obtain the internal ID using `get-timesheet` or `list-timesheets`. This changes approval state and may affect financial workflows. Repeating the request may have secondary effects. Use `import-timesheet` to import hours instead.

functions.name: upload-candidate-attachment
functions.description: Upload exact file content as a candidate attachment with a display name and attachment type.

description.description: Optional attachment description; empty is retained, omission uses provider default.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of exact file bytes, at most 5 MiB decoded; no data-URL prefix.

FunctionInput_jobdiva_uploadcandidateatt.description: Exact file bytes and metadata for one candidate attachment.

FunctionOutput_jobdiva_uploadcandidateat.description: Created attachment identifier and its candidate.

tags.instructions: Use candidateId from `search-candidates` and an attachment type ID from account configuration. Provide exact file bytes as base64, not a URL. Local upload cap is 5 MiB decoded. Use `upload-resume` for a resume. Check `list-candidate-attachments` before replaying an uncertain upload.

functions.name: upload-resume
functions.description: Upload resume text and optional original file content, optionally associating it with an existing candidate.

text.description: Readable resume text, not pre-encoded transport content.

resumeDate.description: Provider resumeDate value preserved opaquely; format and business meaning are not established, so no timestamp conversion is claimed.

candidateId.description: Existing candidate to associate; omission invokes provider candidate matching/creation behavior.

contentBase64.description: Optional original file bytes as standard base64, <=5 MiB decoded; omit for text-only upload.

FunctionInput_jobdiva_uploadresume.description: Resume text, source, and optional original file and candidate association for one upload.

resultId.description: Opaque integer identifier returned by JobDiva; whether it identifies a resume or candidate must be validated before using it as either.

FunctionOutput_jobdiva_uploadresume.description: The opaque result identifier returned for the resume upload.

tags.instructions: Use candidateId from `search-candidates` to associate an existing candidate; omission leaves candidate creation/matching to JobDiva. Supply readable resume text and a configured resume-source ID. Optional exact file bytes use base64, at most 5 MiB decoded. Check candidate/resume records before replaying an uncertain upload.
